research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: Ansa Biotechnologies is researching de novo stepwise template independent synthesis of long polynucleotides, directed evolution methods for template independent polymerases, modified terminal deoxynucleotidyl transferase polymerases, and reversible terminators with enzyme cleavable linkages. They develop cleavable linkers tethering polymerases to nucleotides, compositions for enzymatic polynucleotide synthesis, improved cloning of de novo synthesized polynucleotides, and methods and systems for cyclic enzymatic polymer synthesis.

overview_description.description: Ansa Biotechnologies is manufactured via a chemical method that has remained essentially unchanged for 35 years and has approached a plateau. Ansa Biotechnologies is developing a novel DNA synthesis technology based on enzymes that will be more fast, accurate, and clean than existing methods. The technique promises to dramatically accelerate innovation in biological research and engineering.

about_short_description.short_description: Ansa Biotechnologies develops a novel DNA synthesis technology based on enzymes.

product.name: XL Clonal DNA
product.description: Sequence-verified clonal DNA constructs from 7.5 kb to 50 kb, produced for complex and long sequences without requiring customers to perform the assembly.

product.name: Clonal DNA
product.description: Sequence-verified clonal DNA constructs from 100 bp to 7.5 kb, including complex sequences for cloning, expression, and other molecular biology workflows.

product.name: DNA Fragments
product.description: Sequence-verified linear double-stranded DNA fragments from 200 bp to 900 bp for cloning, assembly, validation, and downstream molecular biology experiments.

product.name: Catalog Vectors
product.description: Ready-to-use vector backbones for cloning, bacterial expression, mammalian expression, AAV applications, and in vitro transcription.

product.name: Custom Vector Onboarding Early Access
product.description: A custom plasmid construction service in which customers upload a vector sequence and Ansa synthesizes and delivers a validated, ready-to-use plasmid.

product.name: Ansa On-Time Guarantee
product.description: A service guarantee covering committed shipping dates for eligible DNA orders; if an eligible order ships late, the order is provided free of charge.
